title: Session loss after a feature flag rollout
root_cause_summary: The flag strict_session_binding was rolled to 100% instead of the intended 5%, invalidating sessions issued before the rollout and logging users out mid-flow.

required_evidence.why: the flag flip one minute before onset, with the wrong percentage
sessions draining rather than a traffic change

red_herrings.why_tempting: a scaling event during the incident, but a consequence of load, not the cause
